text: Your agent can write the eval and score every model.
Until it needs a GPU. Then it waits for you.
Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or Cursor.
The agent installs GPU for Agents by itself.
It checks prices against your budget, asks you once, and rents the GPU.
Minutes later, the model answers on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Vast.ai works out of the box.
For RunPod, Lambda or your own cluster, the agent writes the adapter.
A watchdog runs on the machine itself.
Fifteen minutes with no requests, and it shuts the GPU down, even after the chat is closed.
Your agent rents the GPU it needs, on its own.
You pay only while it works.
